services.name: Hana & Beyond Tour
services.desc: An unforgettable adventure along one of the top five most scenic drives in the world, the legendary Road to Hāna. About We are a Native Hawaiian (Kanaka Maoli), family-owned and operated tour company from Hāna, Maui. Our connection to Hāna is at the heart of everything we do. With knowledge passed down through generations, we create immersive tours that authentically showcase the very best of what Hāna has to offer. ​ When you choose Hāna and Beyond, you're not just embarking on a tour, you're joining us on a voyage of discovery, guided by the spirit of aloha and the deep-rooted love we have People of all ages are welcome to join us

services.name: Shore Excursions of Maui
services.desc: Offering shared group excursions for guests arriving by cruise ship to the port of Kahului. Visit the world famous road to Hana with local tour guides from Maui that offer a unique perspective into local and native culture. Ranked one of the top five most beautiful drives in the world explore the hidden treasure of Maui's beautiful rainforest from the unique rainbow trees to native Hawaiian flora and fauna, learn of what the native Hawaiians introduced to Hawaii and its multiple uses in old Hawaii and observe the daring coastline of east Maui. Enjoy a relaxing drive with the only native Kahului Harbor Pickup Only
